title: Terminals for Agentic Programming — Which Terminal App, on Which OS, for How Many Sessions?
summary: Which terminal to run coding agents in, decided by OS first and concurrent-session count second: a per-OS matrix (macOS/Linux/Windows/remote/mobile), a session-count ladder from 1 to 12+ agents, an 8-criterion scorecard across cmux/Warp/Ghostty/Kitty/WezTerm/tmux/Zellij/herdr, and a gap analysis showing 7 terminal apps (34,747★) missing from the stars against 53 present.
